issues.description: Default speaker for bulbul:v3-beta is inconsistent between docs and config
issues.detail: PR description and TTSModelConfig docstring state the v3-beta default speaker is 'aditya', and TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS docstring/comments say 'aditya', but the actual config sets default_speaker='shubh'. Users relying on the documented default will get a different voice than advertised. Pick one and align docs, enum order, and config.

issues.description: input_audio_codec dropped from STT connect_kwargs causing potential regression
issues.detail: The previous _connect() sent 'input_audio_codec' to the Sarvam SDK; the new version removes it entirely. If the SDK or backend requires this for non-default codecs, existing users passing custom input_audio_codec will silently break. Either restore the key or document that the parameter is deprecated and remove it from __init__.

issues.description: Pace silently clamped instead of validated, masking user error
issues.detail: When pace is outside the v3 range (0.5-2.0), code logs a warning and clamps. Pydantic Field still validates ge=0.3, le=3.0 globally, so a v3 user passing 2.5 gets a silent behavior change rather than a clear error. Either raise ValueError like other unsupported params, or make pace bounds model-aware via a validator.

The previous code accepted both 'bulbul:v3-beta' and 'bulbul:v3' (see the old `if model in ('bulbul:v3-beta', 'bulbul:v3')` branch and the example docstring using 'bulbul:v3'). The new strict validation rejects 'bulbul:v3' with ValueError. Existing callers will break on upgrade. Add 'bulbul:v3' as an alias or note this as a breaking change.

issues.description: Warning comparisons use float equality on defaults, producing false positives
issues.detail: `elif params.pitch != 0.0`, `params.loudness != 1.0`, and `params.temperature != 0.6` warn whenever values differ from defaults. A user constructing InputParams with explicit defaults gets no warning, but anyone passing 0.5999999 (float drift) or relying on Pydantic coercion may get spurious warnings. More importantly, this couples 'user intent' to 'value equals default', which is incorrect. Track whether the field was explicitly set instead.

issues.description: set_prompt no-op behavior change loses the explicit error for non-None prompts on unsupported models
issues.detail: Previously saarika rejected non-None prompts in set_prompt; new code keeps the ValueError but the docstring no longer mentions this. Minor: also, when prompt is None on a non-supporting model, silently returning is fine but should log at debug for diagnosability.

review.summary: The refactor to config-driven model dispatch is a clean improvement, but several behavioral regressions slipped in: the documented v3-beta default speaker disagrees with the actual config ('aditya' vs 'shubh'), input_audio_codec is silently dropped from the STT connect call, and the 'bulbul:v3' alias previously accepted is now rejected outright. Pace clamping and default-value-based warning detection are also fragile. Recommend aligning docs/config, preserving backward compatibility for known model aliases and the codec kwarg, and replacing silent clamping with explicit validation.
